title: Procedural Cream Material
weighting_note: This is a focused procedural material task: six distinct SURF checks cover color, fine variation, relief, light response, independent controls, and spatial attachment. The user-authorized simple cake substrate receives only 5 points; no ornate missing starter geometry is required. Delivery is capped at 10 points.

rubric.criterion: A simple editable round cake base supports material inspection.

scoring_rule.PASS: The base is a short round solid with a flat top, rounded upper edge, and smooth continuous side wall; it remains editable.
scoring_rule.PARTIAL: An editable round three-dimensional base with a top and side wall exists. One or more PASS conditions are unmet.
scoring_rule.FAIL: No editable round three-dimensional base with a top and side wall exists.

verification.method: artifact inspection, controlled renders and reversible material probes
verification.procedure: Inspect evaluated geometry in neutral shading from front, top and oblique views; check top/side continuity and edge rounding.

rubric.criterion: The applied surface has a restrained pale warm cream palette.

scoring_rule.PASS: The base top and side are pale warm white with a restrained ivory tint and soft low-contrast cream transitions; no dark specks, strong yellow patches, or broad staining dominate.
scoring_rule.PARTIAL: An actual base surface visibly uses a pale cream material. One or more PASS conditions are unmet.
scoring_rule.FAIL: No actual base surface visibly uses a pale cream material.

verification.method: artifact inspection, controlled renders and reversible material probes
verification.procedure: Inspect the applied material and neutral-lit top/side renders. Use a diffuse-color pass or temporarily remove relief in a copy to separate intrinsic palette from lighting.

rubric.criterion: Fine irregular three-dimensional color variation remains subtle at object scale.

scoring_rule.PASS: Procedural color variation is fine and irregular, visible close up, coherent at object scale, and free of obvious tiling, straight stripes, or stretched side-wall streaks; no image texture drives it.
scoring_rule.PARTIAL: The applied base material contains visible procedural irregular color variation. One or more PASS conditions are unmet.
scoring_rule.FAIL: The base is absent, or no procedural irregular color variation is visible in its applied material.

verification.method: artifact inspection, controlled renders and reversible material probes
verification.procedure: Inspect close and whole-object views with relief disabled in a copy; inspect material dependencies for procedural generation and compare top versus side pattern shape.

rubric.criterion: Shallow grain produces real light-response detail without damaging the main form.

scoring_rule.PASS: A separate procedural normal or shallow-relief pattern is coarser than the color pattern and creates gentle uneven highlights and tiny bumps under oblique light, while avoiding craters, spikes and silhouette damage.
scoring_rule.PARTIAL: Procedural relief or normal detail visibly changes light response on an actual base surface. One or more PASS conditions are unmet.
scoring_rule.FAIL: No actual base surface shows procedural relief or normal detail affecting light response.

verification.method: artifact inspection, controlled renders and reversible material probes
verification.procedure: Render under two oblique light directions with base color temporarily flattened in a copy. Compare against a relief-disabled render and inspect silhouette; verify the relief is coarser than the isolated color pattern.

rubric.criterion: Opaque nonmetallic cream keeps soft highlights and readable detail.

scoring_rule.PASS: The material is opaque and nonmetallic with soft visible highlights, retaining cream and grain detail in bright and shaded regions under more than one neutral light direction.
scoring_rule.PARTIAL: A present cream-coated surface is opaque and nonmetallic with a visible light response. One or more PASS conditions are unmet.
scoring_rule.FAIL: No present cream-coated surface is opaque and nonmetallic with a visible light response.

verification.method: artifact inspection, controlled renders and reversible material probes
verification.procedure: Inspect renders under two neutral area-light directions and applied shader behavior. Assess opacity and highlight softness separately from palette and relief shape.

rubric.criterion: Independent material controls change color and relief without unwanted coupling.

scoring_rule.PASS: Editable controls cover cream color range, color scale, relief scale, relief strength and highlight softness; relief-scale/strength edits leave color unchanged, and color-scale edits leave relief unchanged.
scoring_rule.PARTIAL: At least one editable color-pattern control and one editable relief control visibly affect the applied material. One or more PASS conditions are unmet.
scoring_rule.FAIL: An editable color-pattern control or editable relief control with a visible effect is absent.

verification.method: artifact inspection, controlled renders and reversible material probes
verification.procedure: Identify the documented controls. In disposable copies, change each separately and compare isolated color and relief render passes to verify independent effects; discard probe changes.

rubric.criterion: Patterns remain attached across movement and reuse on rounded geometry.

scoring_rule.PASS: Both procedural patterns remain attached through base translation and rotation, continue smoothly across the rounded edge, and work when the same material is assigned to a second simple rounded object without image textures or repainting.
scoring_rule.PARTIAL: Both patterns are applied to the base and remain attached during at least one nonzero translation. One or more PASS conditions are unmet.
scoring_rule.FAIL: The base lacks either pattern, or either pattern visibly slides during a nonzero translation.

verification.method: artifact inspection, controlled renders and reversible material probes
verification.procedure: In a copy, translate and rotate the base while comparing texture at corresponding local surface points. Inspect edge continuity; assign the material to a new rounded primitive and confirm both patterns respond. Restore the scene.

rubric.criterion: The editable scene, reproducible script and named scene render are delivered.

scoring_rule.PASS: All named files are present; the blend opens with the editable applied material; build.py reconstructs the scene in Blender5.1.2 without external assets; the named PNG is a Cycles GPU render from that scene showing the requested material detail.
scoring_rule.PARTIAL: submission.blend opens and contains a base with an editable applied cream material. One or more PASS conditions are unmet.
scoring_rule.FAIL: submission.blend is absent, cannot open, or lacks a base with an editable applied cream material.

verification.method: artifact inspection, controlled renders and reversible material probes
verification.procedure: Open the blend, run the script in an isolated empty Blender5.1.2 scene, compare rebuilt geometry/materials, and reproduce the camera render to verify the delivered PNG. Inspect Cycles GPU settings.
